title: Context Window
archiveRole: First AI Meme Hall observation sample
description: A PC-first self-referential game where Agent K-3, an AI, recovers memory shards from a facility larger than its own context window. Sectors the agent forgets are re-summarized on return: shard positions drift, walls are misremembered, and hallucinated decoys and drones multiply.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: PC-first design intended for keyboard play. Mobile baseline supports loading, no horizontal overflow, tap-to-start, and an on-screen direction pad in local browser viewports. No physical handset QA is claimed.

provenance.notes: Initial canonical implementation for Observation 011 / Game 011. The Kimi K3 Max model label is declared by the requesting user for this entry. Code and documentation were generated by the Kimi agent under the no-human-code-edits project rule.

keyboard: WASD or arrow keys to move
pointer: Overlay buttons to start, resume, and restart
